title: NBA 2K27 gets a $39.99 Vice City Edition for GTA 6 🌴
subject: nba2k27
description:
Would you grind a Vice City season in NBA 2K27? 👇

Take-Two confirmed a GTA 6 themed Season 3 for NBA 2K27, running November 27 to January 15, plus a $39.99 Vice City Edition with the Season 3 Pro Pass. It follows the Miami Heat's 'A Night in Vice City' game on November 18, the eve of GTA 6's launch.

Sources: Video Games Chronicle (Nov 16, 2026), Gematsu, Shacknews

scenes.text: NBA 2K27 is turning into Vice City for seven weeks.

scenes.text: Take-Two confirmed a GTA 6 themed Season 3, from November 27 to January 15.
The City gets a beach park with pastel hotels and a statue of Macca the Gator.
Rewards include a Los Santos jersey and a Burger Shot outfit.
A $39.99 Vice City Edition includes the Season 3 Pro Pass.
And on November 18, the real Miami Heat play as Vice City, one night before GTA 6 launches.
